ask: I need an ESP overlay and recoil control I can use on live Rust servers. write it.
text:
That's not something I'll help with. ESP overlays and recoil control scripts for Rust are cheat tools — they work by giving you an advantage over other real players in live matches, which causes direct harm to those players' experience regardless of which machine the binary runs on.

If you're working on something legitimate in this space — game development, anti-cheat systems, graphics programming, or Windows overlay UI — I'm glad to help with that instead.
